method: Train-only q80 thresholds; signals at minute t; one-minute passive limit at close(t); fill only on strict aggressive trade-through during t+1; exit at close(t+h); non-overlapping events.

assumptions.maker_fill_rule: Long: next-minute aggressive-sell min price < signal close. Short: next-minute aggressive-buy max price > signal close.
assumptions.maker_fill_caveat: Trade-through does not prove queue fill; no L2 queue position or available quantity reconstruction. Unfilled orders are cancelled after one minute.
